detail: NFL.com official injury report lists Ben Brown as C (Week 10, Knee, Out). The club-published depth chart at patriots.com/team/depth-chart (fetched 2026-11-14) lists him 1st-string LG and 2nd-string C (behind Jared Wilson). The former third-party chart's RG value is unsupported by the club chart and has been removed from the table.
reason: The official injury report and the official-domain club chart use different position bases (C vs LG). No single official position basis is defined, so the deficiency is described but not numerically scored.

item: Depth charts: club official pages located and used, with a self-labeled 'unofficial' caveat
detail: No league-level official depth chart exists: the NFL.com team depth-chart URLs checked return 404 (session 30beeb55, session 7c9eb69a). The clubs' own official websites do publish weekly charts — detroitlions.com/team/depth-chart ('2026 Unofficial Depth Chart Compiled by Lions Football Communications') and patriots.com/team/depth-chart ('unofficial and is published by the writers of Patriots.com', reflecting writer opinion). Both pages sit on official club domains and are linked from the NFL.com team roster pages. Depth ordering in the table is now verified against these club charts (fetched 2026-11-14, session 52ca9f77). Third-party charts (ESPN, Ourlads) remain leads only and are not used as evidence.
reason: Club charts are the best available official-domain depth evidence, but they self-describe as unofficial/editorial. Ordering values are filled only where a club chart confirms them, with this caveat attached to every such row.

detail: A machine-readable official player-level stats feed has not been confirmed.
reason: Team-level stats are confirmed official; player-level stats require a confirmed automatable endpoint before player-prop signals can be fully sourced.

detail: NFL.com Terms and Conditions Section 1.3 states that systematic retrieval to compile a collection/database is prohibited absent express prior written consent.
reason: No automated scraping of NFL.com should be implemented until authorized access and reuse terms are documented. Mirrors suggested F16 from the d80442c2 audit.
